text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today.
Biko Pegasus is deep in conversation
next to Hishi Akebono, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, really~?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, big news!
Bono finally......"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I heard she's scheduled to make her debut this autumn!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, thank you~.
It's all thanks to you and
Biko-chan, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Um, so debuting in the Junior class this year
means she'll be one year behind Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! But soon enough we'll be racing together, so being an upperclassman or underclassman won't even matter.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "This summer, let's both train our hearts out toward our goals!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, strict and tough! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We made it! Whoaaa, it's the sea, the seaaa!
All right, let's get right to—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Time to train!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do it with an extra-large serving of full power~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ――Ah! I got so excited that I accidentally brought out my break-time item...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no...!
That doesn't count! We'll play later!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~,
I ended up packing a ton of stuff.
I'm just way too excited for our beach sleepover~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We've got a buono watermelon, a shaved ice machine, and fishing rods, so we can catch some fish too♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Fireworks, playing cards, and a bug-catching net—we're totally set!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Things over there are perfect too, of course, so no need to worry!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Good kids put training first.
You can only touch these during breaks. That's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to become the strong hero I've always admired,
I'm gonna give it my all this summer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna get more and more buono
to get ready for my debut, too~!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Bono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!
Ooh-♪

I was worried for a moment, but deep down, they're earnest girls.
They'll run hard, play hard, and grow immensely this summer without a doubt.
